title: LSTM microstate representations distinguish stress-associated EEG dynamics
summary: LSTM autoencoder representations captured EEG microstate sequences at several timescales and distinguished baseline from post-stress recordings where conventional summary measures did not. A coupled classifier reported 67–73% accuracy across sequence lengths. The analysis used existing experimental datasets, including recordings in 34 men; it does not establish a general stress diagnostic or a causal interpretation of the learned temporal patterns.
